definitions.gloss: skin type; skin quality; skin texture
definitions.explanation: The natural characteristics and condition of a person's skin, such as whether it is oily, dry, sensitive, or combination. Widely used in skincare, cosmetics, and dermatology.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{肌質|はだしつ}を{知|し}ることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to know your own skin type.

examples.japanese: {肌質|はだしつ}に{合|あ}った{化粧水|けしょうすい}を{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Please choose a toner that suits your skin type.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}には{肌質|はだしつ}が{変化|へんか}しやすいので、スキンケアを{見直|みなお}すとよい。
examples.english: Skin type tends to change at the turn of the seasons, so it's good to reconsider your skincare routine.

notes:
Composed of {肌|はだ} (skin) and {質|しつ} (quality, nature). A core term in the Japanese beauty and skincare industry, which is one of the largest in the world. Understanding this word is essential for shopping for cosmetics or visiting a dermatologist in Japan.

COMMON SKIN TYPES:
- {乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}: dry skin
- {脂性肌|しせいはだ}: oily skin
- {混合肌|こんごうはだ}: combination skin
- {敏感肌|びんかんはだ}: sensitive skin
- {普通肌|ふつうはだ}: normal skin

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肌質|はだしつ}に{合|あ}う: to suit one's skin type
- {肌質|はだしつ}を{改善|かいぜん}する: to improve skin quality
- {肌質|はだしつ}{診断|しんだん}: skin type analysis
- {肌質|はだしつ}が{変|か}わる: skin type changes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肌|はだ}: skin — the body part itself
- {肌触|はだざわ}り: texture, feel (of skin or fabric) — how something feels to the touch
- {体質|たいしつ}: constitution, physical makeup — broader term for overall body type
